decisions.reason: The Heading 3 typography change is owned by the atomic Heading 3 Requirement; the obligation to implement the complete style catalog remains valid unchanged.
Changing Heading 3 weight while retaining its size does not change the style prefix, naming coverage, naming condition, or language.
The source changes Heading 3 typography, not bullet size, appearance, alignment, or scaling.
Heading 3 font size and weight do not alter Tab-driven sublevel creation or nested-list hierarchy behavior.
The source does not change legacy-content paste behavior, stability constraints, or test files.
The Heading 3 typography decision does not affect pasted-table structure or right-hand column containment.
The source does not change the required behavior of manual line breaks after pasting.
The specific Heading 3 typography change does not alter the supported Word environment or the general reliability and multi-user stability constraints.
The same message separately reports numbered-list alignment failure, which is already represented in this candidate's history; the Heading 3 MODIFY does not change that Requirement.
Heading 3 size and weight do not resolve or change the template default-language requirement or its existing ambiguity.
